Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1005
Claimant:
Kristy Wood
Adjuster:
Valerie Rodriguez
May 21, 2024
Calim opened following a rear-end collision in which the insured's vehicle was struck from behind while stopped at a
traffic signal. The claimant is represented by counsel, and all further contact is being routed through the attorney's
office.
June 2, 2024
Confirmed that the driver is named on the policy and that the policy was in focre at the time of loss. Police report
obtained and reviewed.
June 8, 2024
Statements from the other driver, two independent witnesses, and scene photographs all agree on how the collision
occurred. The vehicle was in the claimant's lane and was struck at moderate speed by the trailing vehicle.
July 18, 2024
Police and both witnesses confirm the claimant was seated in the vehicle at the time of impact. No conflicting
information has been received on this point.
August 13, 2024
Medical records received from the claimant's treating providers document a concussion. The reported symptoms and
the force of the impact are consistent with one another. No prior injury to the same body area is known from the file or
from the claimant's history given so far.
August 29, 2024
Treatment has continued somewhat longer than is typical for this type of injury. Requested updated records and a
treatment timeline from counsel to understand the reasons for the extended care.
September 23, 2024
Claimant has added some smaller details to the account since the first interview, but the core description of events
has not changed. Repair estimate reviewed; it is not yet clear whether all listed damage resulted from this impact, so
the vehicle has been referred for a closer inspection.
October 13, 2024
A neighbor has told the field representative that the vehicle appeared damaged a few weeks before the claimed loss
date. This has not been verified and is being noted for follow-up. No earlier damage to the vehicle is recorded in the
file at this time, and the claim remains under review.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
